biological_vulnerability: AML cells may have heightened reliance on protein homeostasis mechanisms (e.g., UPR, proteasome activity, chaperone systems) to cope with oncogenic stress or rapid protein synthesis.
selection_rationale: This was the weakest ER/UPR-positive axis from the chosen v52_v39_mech_granularity setup: UPR appears only as an example inside a broader proteostasis axis, rather than as a parent ER/UPR axis.
non_overlap_rationale: Distinct from lysosomal/autophagy axes when focused on protein quality-control stress, proteasome, chaperones, and UPR-linked proteostasis overload.
underexplored_state_or_context: Stress-adapted AML states that rely on proteostasis buffering under oncogenic or therapeutic stress.
